# klvr

> klvr is a web development, software, and brand agency serving startups, schools, real estate firms, e-commerce brands, and professional service businesses worldwide. We are one team that replaces the freelancers a growing business usually needs (website developer, app developer, social media manager, and more), and we stay on as a long-term technology and creative partner after launch.

## What we do

- Custom software, CRM, and school/business management systems
- Website design and development, including e-commerce
- Workflow automation and AI integration
- Brand identity, positioning, and visual design
- Content, photography, and videography
- Marketing strategy and growth campaigns
- Ongoing monthly retainers and growth partnerships

## Who we serve

Small and medium-sized businesses (5-200 employees), venture-backed startups, private schools, real estate companies, and automotive dealerships, worldwide. Secondary: churches and faith-based organizations, e-commerce brands, logistics companies, and professional service firms (law, accounting, consulting, healthcare).
